AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description:
This app provides tools for podcast discovery, management, and playback.
Operational Patterns: - Always use 'searchPodcasts' or 'searchEpisodes' to find valid entities and IDs before attempting playback functions if the specific ID is unknown. - Prefer 'playLatestEpisode' for quick voice-triggered playback of known shows. - Use 'addToQueue' for hands-free playlist management without interrupting current playback. - Use 'getPlaybackState' to verify what is currently playing or to check progress. - Control playback flow using 'pausePlayback', 'resumePlayback', 'skipForward', 'skipBackward', 'skipToNext', and 'skipToPrevious'.
Constraints: - Playback requires an active internet connection for streaming. - Search results are limited to the 20 most relevant matches.
